decision_conditions: It has not been demonstrated, on the balance of probability, that the proposed mobile home would function as part of the existing Use Class C4 HMO. The unit would be self-contained, physically separate, and capable of independent occupation. On the evidence submitted, it is not demonstrated that it would remain integrated with the HMO use. The proposal would therefore create a separate planning unit, constituting a material change of use requiring planning permission under Section 57 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

It has not been demonstrated, on the balance of probability, that the proposed structure meets the statutory definition of a caravan under the Caravan Sites and Control of Development Act 1960 and the Caravan Sites Act 1968, particularly regarding construction and mobility. The applicant has not submitted technical evidence (such as structural details, lifting specifications, or method statements) to show the unit could be constructed/assembled on site or moved intact. On this basis, the siting of the unit may constitute operational development or other operations under Section 55 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
